Bid Summary.value: Dallas ISD is issuing this RFP to procure student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablets, and monitors. The estimated quantities are significant, with a total of 50,000 Chromebooks and 5,000 Windows laptops required over the contract term. The due date for submissions is July 9, 2024, at 2:00 PM CST. The contract will be for an initial term of three years, with two one-year extensions possible. Vendors must provide a detailed plan for tracking shipments and deployment services.

Product Specification.value: Student Chromebook: Intel Celeron Processor N100, 8GB DDR5 RAM, 64GB eMMC, 11.6" display, 1-year warranty. Windows Laptop: Intel i5 13th Gen, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 512GB NVMe SSD, 13" display, 3-year warranty. Warranty service within 5 business days.
